scope: Read-only local resource and historical 8B training check while the Fold 2 4B queue was running. No 8B model was loaded or run locally.

historical_8b_seoul_l4_training.recipe: NF4 with double quantization and BF16 compute, unquantized visual and lm_head, SDPA, multimodal LoRA with language and visual mergers, AdamW

assessment.nf4_training: Historical 9.0 GiB peak reserved plus the prior desktop baseline gives roughly 1.2 GiB raw capacity margin. Windows residency budget, loader commit, fragmentation and transient demand vary; neither fit nor speed on RTX 3060 is confirmed.
assessment.bf16_inference: The four source shards alone occupy about 16.33 GiB on disk, exceeding 12 GiB even before adapter, image activations or KV cache. The normal single-GPU BF16 loader maps the whole model to CUDA device 0, so reducing batch size cannot make that recipe resident. NF4 or CPU offload would be separate experimental conditions; neither was launched.
assessment.execution_policy: The active Fold 2 4B train, BF16 evaluation and scoring retain exclusive local use. An 8B smoke is not scheduled.
